headline: ARI @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.57 at CIN 4.37, with a projected total of 8.94. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (ARI +0.23, CIN +0.32), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.55, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Geraldo Perdomo, JJ Bleday, Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Spencer Steer because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
